name: golf
description: Golf Intelligence, by Stracka. The highest-quality golf course dataset for developers building a golf app. 20 years of proprietary mapping (laser, drone, airplane, satellite), updated daily. Search is free. Scorecards, GPS, and 3D greens via API. Not a scrape.
